verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product or agent that could act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error. Its internal use of AI and its legal advice on AI matters do not mean it ships an MCP client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
